scripts.dev: npm run db:prepare && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:apphosting: npm --prefix packages/contracts install --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix packages/contracts run build && npm --prefix apps/web install --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @global-wallet/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:prepare: npm run db:up && docker compose up -d --wait postgres && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
